    activeDropdown: null,
    activeSidebarItem: 'ideias',
    init() {
        this.fetchCotacoes();
    },
    closeSearch() {
        const searchEl = document.querySelector('.site-header--search');
        const overlayEl = document.querySelector('.overlay');
        if (searchEl &amp;&amp; searchEl.classList.contains('open')) {
            searchEl.classList.remove('open');
            if (overlayEl) overlayEl.classList.remove('show');
        }
    },
    openMercado(item = 'ideias') {
        this.closeSearch();
        this.activeSidebarItem = item;
        this.activeDropdown = 'mercado';
    },
    openFerramentas() {
        this.closeSearch();
        this.activeDropdown = 'ferramentas';
    },
    openIrpf() {
        this.closeSearch();
        this.activeDropdown = 'irpf';
    },
    close() {
        this.activeDropdown = null;
    },
    cotacoesLoaded: false,
    fetchCotacoes() {
        if (this.cotacoesLoaded) return;
        this.cotacoesLoaded = true;

        const rows = this.$el.querySelectorAll('[data-ticker]');
        const tickers = [...new Set([...rows].map(r => r.dataset.ticker))];
        if (!tickers.length) return;

        const chunkSize = 10;
        const chunks = [];
        for (let i = 0; i < tickers.length; i += chunkSize) {
            chunks.push(tickers.slice(i, i + chunkSize));
        }

        chunks.forEach(chunk => {
            fetch('/api/cotacoes/batch?tickers=' + chunk.join(','))
                .then(r => r.json())
                .then(data => {
                    rows.forEach(row => {
                        const ticker = row.dataset.ticker;
                        const info = data[ticker];
                        if (!info || !info.price) return;

                        const priceEl = row.querySelector('.menu-v2__ticker-price, .menu-v2__etfs-price, .menu-v2__criptos-price');
                        if (priceEl) {
                            const text = priceEl.textContent.trim();
                            const prefix = text.startsWith('US$') ? 'US$ ' : text.startsWith('$') ? '$ ' : 'R$ ';
                            priceEl.textContent = prefix + parseFloat(info.price).toLocaleString('pt-BR', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 });
                        }
                    });
                })
                .catch(() => {});
        });
    }

<script>
(function checkDependenciesQuotationInfoBr() {
     if (typeof jQuery === 'undefined' || typeof formatMoney === 'undefined' || !window.i10CustomPeriod) {
         setTimeout(checkDependenciesQuotationInfoBr, 50);
         return;
     }

     let urlQuotationBaseBr = 'https://investidor10.com.br/api/cotacoes/acao/chart/CMIG4/';
     const quotationVariableBr = '';

     // Escopo do período personalizado desta seção. Sem ele, um calendário de
     // outro widget da mesma página (ex.: comparador de ativos) recarregaria a
     // cotação com o período dele.
     const periodScopeBr = 'period-quotation-select';
     const isCustomPeriodActiveBr = () => window.i10CustomPeriod.isActive(periodScopeBr);
     const clearCustomPeriodBr = () => window.i10CustomPeriod.deactivate(periodScopeBr);

     const getVariationBr = (precoInicial, precoFinal) => {
         const variacao = ((precoFinal - precoInicial) / precoInicial) * 100;
         return variacao.toFixed(2);
     }

     const getBoxDailyVariationBr = () => {
         const badge = $('#cards-ticker ._card.cotacao .daily-variation-badge').first();
         if (badge.length === 0) {
             return null;
         }
         const rawText = badge.text().replace('%', '').replace(/\./g, '').replace(',', '.').trim();
         if (rawText === '' || isNaN(parseFloat(rawText))) {
             return null;
         }
         let value = Math.abs(parseFloat(rawText));
         if (badge.hasClass('daily-variation-badge--negative')) {
             value = -value;
         }
         return value.toFixed(2);
     }

     const getPriceQuotationsBr = (days) => {
         let urlRequestQuotation;

                  if (days === 1 && !isCustomPeriodActiveBr()) {
             urlRequestQuotation = 'https://investidor10.com.br/api/quotations/one-day/CMIG4/';
         } else if (days === 7 && !isCustomPeriodActiveBr()) {
             urlRequestQuotation = 'https://investidor10.com.br/api/quotations/seven-days/CMIG4/';
                      } else {
                          let usePayments = ($('#usePayments').val() == 'adjusted');
             urlRequestQuotation = urlQuotationBaseBr + days + '/' + usePayments;
                      }
         
         return $.get(urlRequestQuotation).then(function(data) {
             let selectedData;

             if ((days == 1 || days == 7) && !isCustomPeriodActiveBr()) {
                                      let quotationType = 'real';
                     let currencySelector = $('[id$="-selector-select"]');
                     if (currencySelector.length > 0) {
                         let selectedValues = currencySelector.val();
                         if (selectedValues) {
                             quotationType = Array.isArray(selectedValues) ? (selectedValues[0] || 'real') : (selectedValues || 'real');
                         }
                     }
                    const normalizedQuotationType = quotationType === 'dollar' ? 'dolar' : quotationType;
                    selectedData = data[normalizedQuotationType] || data.dolar || data.dollar || data.real || [];
                              } else {
                 if (Array.isArray(data)) {
                     selectedData = data;
                 } else {
                     let quotationType = 'real';
                     let currencySelector = $('[id$="-selector-select"]');
                     if (currencySelector.length > 0) {
                         let selectedValues = currencySelector.val();
                         if (selectedValues) {
                             quotationType = Array.isArray(selectedValues) ? (selectedValues[0] || 'real') : (selectedValues || 'real');
                         }
                     }
                    const normalizedQuotationType = quotationType === 'dollar' ? 'dolar' : quotationType;
                    selectedData = data[normalizedQuotationType] || data.dolar || data.dollar || data.real || [];
                 }
             }

             if (selectedData.length === 0) {
                 return {
                     firstPriceCotation: {
                         price: 0
                     }
                     , lastPriceCotation: {
                         price: 0
                     }
                 };
             }

             let firstPriceCotation = selectedData[0];
             let lastPriceCotation = selectedData[selectedData.length - 1];

             return {
                 firstPriceCotation
                 , lastPriceCotation
             };
         });
     };

     const getSelectedQuotationFieldBr = () => {
         let currencySelector = $('[id$="-selector-select"]');
         if (currencySelector.length > 0) {
             let selectedValues = currencySelector.val();
             if (selectedValues) {
                 const selectedCurrency = (Array.isArray(selectedValues) ? (selectedValues[0] || 'real') : selectedValues).toLowerCase();
                 if (selectedCurrency === 'real' || selectedCurrency === 'brl') {
                     return 'brl_price';
                 }
                 if (selectedCurrency === 'dollar' || selectedCurrency === 'dolar' || selectedCurrency === 'usd') {
                     return 'dolar_price';
                 }
             }
         }
         return null;
     };

     const updateDataLayoutBr = (data) => {
        
        let currencySymbol = "";
        let sufix = quotationVariableBr === 'points' ? 'pontos' : '';
        if (quotationVariableBr !== 'points') {
            currencySymbol = data.currencySymbol || 'R$';
        }

         const boxPrice = $('#cards-ticker ._card.cotacao ._card-body .value').first().text().trim();
         if (quotationVariableBr !== 'points' && /\d/.test(boxPrice)) {
             $('.info-price').text(boxPrice);
         } else {
             $('.info-price').text(formatMoneyDisplay(`${currencySymbol} ${formatMoney(data.lastPrice)} ${quotationVariableBr === 'points' ? sufix : ''}`));
         }

         $('.info-percentage').text(`${data.percentage}`);
         $('.info-percentage').css(`${data.percentage}`);
         $('.info-variation').text(data.textVariation);

         if (data.percentage.includes('+')) {
             $('.info-percentage').removeClass('tw-text-color-text-error-light').addClass('tw-text-color-text-success-light');
             $('.info-variation').removeClass('tw-text-color-text-error-light').addClass('tw-text-color-text-success-light');
         } else {
             $('.info-percentage').removeClass('tw-text-color-text-success-light').addClass('tw-text-color-text-error-light');
             $('.info-variation').removeClass('tw-text-color-text-success-light').addClass('tw-text-color-text-error-light');
         }
     };

     $(window).on('load', function() {
         const defaultCurrency = 'R$';
        const isInternationalContext = false;

         function loadQuotationDataBr(period, textVariation) {
             let currencySelector = $('[id$="-selector-select"]');
            let selectedCurrency = null;
             let currencySymbol = defaultCurrency;
            let hasExplicitCurrencySelection = false;

             if (currencySelector.length > 0) {
                 let selectedValues = currencySelector.val();
                 if (selectedValues) {
                     selectedCurrency = Array.isArray(selectedValues) ? (selectedValues[0] || 'real') : selectedValues;
                    hasExplicitCurrencySelection = true;
                 }
             }

             // Also check commodity-specific selector
             let commoditySelector = $('#ticket-selector-select-commodity');
             if (commoditySelector.length > 0) {
                 selectedCurrency = commoditySelector.val() || 'BRL';
                hasExplicitCurrencySelection = true;
             }

            if (hasExplicitCurrencySelection && selectedCurrency) {
                let normalizedCurrency = selectedCurrency.toLowerCase();
                if (window.i10Currency && typeof window.i10Currency.byCode === 'function') {
                    currencySymbol = window.i10Currency.byCode(normalizedCurrency, isInternationalContext);
                } else {
                    if (normalizedCurrency === 'dollar' || normalizedCurrency === 'dolar') currencySymbol = 'US$';
                    else if (normalizedCurrency === 'real' || normalizedCurrency === 'brl') currencySymbol = 'R$';
                    else if (normalizedCurrency === 'euro') currencySymbol = '€';
                    else currencySymbol = defaultCurrency;
                }
             }

             getPriceQuotationsBr(period).then(prices => {
                 const dynamicQuotationField = quotationVariableBr || getSelectedQuotationFieldBr();
                 let firstPrice = dynamicQuotationField
                    ? (prices.firstPriceCotation[dynamicQuotationField] ?? prices.firstPriceCotation.price)
                    : prices.firstPriceCotation.price;
                 let lastPrice = dynamicQuotationField
                    ? (prices.lastPriceCotation[dynamicQuotationField] ?? prices.lastPriceCotation.price)
                    : prices.lastPriceCotation.price;
                 let variation = getVariationBr(firstPrice, lastPrice);
                 if (Number(period) === 1 && !isCustomPeriodActiveBr()) {
                     const boxVariation = getBoxDailyVariationBr();
                     if (boxVariation !== null) {
                         variation = boxVariation;
                     }
                 }
                 updateDataLayoutBr({
                     lastPrice: lastPrice
                     , percentage: variation > 0 ? ` + ${formatMoney(variation)}%` : ` ${formatMoney(variation)}%`
                     , textVariation: `(${textVariation})`
                     , currencySymbol: currencySymbol
                 });
             });
         }

         let isHandlingPeriodClick = false;

         $('.period-quotation').on('click', function() {
             if ($(this).hasClass('action-login')) return;
             clearCustomPeriodBr();
             isHandlingPeriodClick = true;
             let period = $(this).data('period');
             let textVariation = $(this).html().trim();
             loadQuotationDataBr(period, textVariation);
             setTimeout(() => { isHandlingPeriodClick = false; }, 150);
         });

         $('#usePayments').on('change', function() {

             let activeElement = $('.period-quotation.active');

             if (activeElement.length === 0) {
                 activeElement = $('.period-quotation').first();
             }

             const period = activeElement.data('period');
             const textVariation = activeElement.html().trim();
             loadQuotationDataBr(period, textVariation);
         });

         $('[id$="-selector-select"]').on('change', function() {
             let activeElement = $('.period-quotation.active');

             if (activeElement.length === 0) {
                 activeElement = $('.period-quotation').first();
             }

             const period = activeElement.data('period');
             const textVariation = activeElement.html().trim();
             loadQuotationDataBr(period, textVariation);
         });

         $('#ticket-selector-select-commodity').on('change', function() {
             let activeElement = $('.period-quotation.active');

             if (activeElement.length === 0) {
                 activeElement = $('.period-quotation').first();
             }

             const period = activeElement.data('period');
             const textVariation = activeElement.html().trim();
             loadQuotationDataBr(period, textVariation);
         });

         $('#' + periodScopeBr).on('change', function() {
             if (isHandlingPeriodClick) return;
             if (isCustomPeriodActiveBr()) return;

             let period = Number($(this).val());
             if (!period || isNaN(period)) return;

             let activeElement = $(`.period-quotation[data-period="${period}"]`);
             let textVariation;

             if (activeElement.length > 0) {
                 textVariation = activeElement.html().trim();
             } else if (period === 1) {
                 textVariation = '1 D';
             } else {
                 textVariation = $(this).find('option:selected').text().trim() || (period + ' D');
             }

             loadQuotationDataBr(period, textVariation);
         });

         document.addEventListener('customPeriodSelected', function(e) {
             if (e.detail.scope && e.detail.scope !== periodScopeBr) return;
             let startDate = e.detail.startDate;
             let endDate = e.detail.endDate;
             let diffDays = Math.ceil((endDate - startDate) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
             if (diffDays < 1) diffDays = 1;
             loadQuotationDataBr(diffDays, 'Personalizado');
         });

         if ($('.period-quotation').length > 0) {

             let defaultElement = $('.period-quotation.active');

             if (defaultElement.length === 0) {
                 defaultElement = $('.period-quotation').first();
             }

             const defaultPeriod = defaultElement.data('period');
             const defaultText = defaultElement.html().trim();
             loadQuotationDataBr(defaultPeriod, defaultText);
         }
     });
})();
</script>

<script>
(function checkDependenciesPeriodSim_default() {
    if (typeof jQuery === 'undefined' || typeof formatMoney === 'undefined' || !window.i10CustomPeriod) {
        setTimeout(checkDependenciesPeriodSim_default, 50);
        return;
    }

    const periodOptions_default = {
                    "1": "1 dia",
                    "7": "7 dias",
                    "30": "30 dias",
                    "182": "6 meses",
                    "288": "YTD",
                    "365": "1 ano",
                    "1825": "5 anos",
                    "3650": "10 anos",
                    "5475": "15 anos",
            };

    $(window).on('load', function() {
        const defaultCurrency = "R$";
        const isInternationalContext = false;
        const componentId = "default";
        const quotationVariable = "";

        // Escopo do período personalizado da barra de período que este simulador
        // espelha. Um calendário de outro widget na mesma página não deve
        // disparar simulação aqui.
        const periodScope = "period-quotation-select";
        const isCustomPeriodActive = () => window.i10CustomPeriod.isActive(periodScope);
        const clearCustomPeriod = () => window.i10CustomPeriod.deactivate(periodScope);
        const $periodBar = () => $('.segmented-period-bar[data-select-id="' + periodScope + '"]');

        const getCurrencySymbol = () => {
            let currencySelector = $('[id$="-selector-select"]');
            if (currencySelector.length > 0) {
                let selectedValues = currencySelector.val();
                if (selectedValues) {
                    let selectedCurrency = Array.isArray(selectedValues) ? (selectedValues[0] || 'real') : selectedValues;
                    if (window.i10Currency && typeof window.i10Currency.byCode === 'function') {
                        return window.i10Currency.byCode(selectedCurrency, isInternationalContext);
                    }
                    if (selectedCurrency === 'dollar' || selectedCurrency === 'dolar') return 'US$';
                    if (selectedCurrency === 'euro') return '€';
                    if (selectedCurrency === 'real') return 'R$';
                }
            }

            // Also check commodity-specific selector
            let commoditySelector = $('#ticket-selector-select-commodity');
            if (commoditySelector.length > 0) {
                let val = (commoditySelector.val() || '').toLowerCase();
                if (window.i10Currency && typeof window.i10Currency.byCode === 'function') {
                    return window.i10Currency.byCode(val, isInternationalContext);
                }
                if (val === 'dolar') return 'US$';
                if (val === 'brl') return 'R$';
            }

            return defaultCurrency;
        };

        const getSelectedQuotationField = () => {
            let currencySelector = $('[id$="-selector-select"]');
            if (currencySelector.length > 0) {
                let selectedValues = currencySelector.val();
                if (selectedValues) {
                    const selectedCurrency = (Array.isArray(selectedValues) ? (selectedValues[0] || 'real') : selectedValues).toLowerCase();
                    if (selectedCurrency === 'real' || selectedCurrency === 'brl') {
                        return 'brl_price';
                    }
                    if (selectedCurrency === 'dollar' || selectedCurrency === 'dolar' || selectedCurrency === 'usd') {
                        return 'dolar_price';
                    }
                }
            }
            return null;
        };

        let currencySymbol = getCurrencySymbol();

        let usePayments = ($('#usePayments').val() == 'adjusted');
        let days = $("#period-simulation-select-default").val() || "365";
        let urlQuotationBase = 'https://investidor10.com.br/api/cotacoes/acao/chart/CMIG4/';

        const htmlLang = document.documentElement.lang || 'pt-br';
        const isPtBr = htmlLang.toLowerCase() === 'pt-br' || htmlLang.toLowerCase() === 'pt_br' || htmlLang.toLowerCase() === 'pt';

        $("#period-simulation-input-default").maskMoney({
            prefix: formatMoneyDisplay(`${isInternationalContext ? '$' : currencySymbol} `),
            thousands: isPtBr ? '.' : ',',
            decimal: isPtBr ? ',' : '.',
            allowZero: true,
            affixesStay: true
        }).maskMoney('mask');

        let valueSimulator = $("#period-simulation-input-default").maskMoney('unmasked')[0] || 1000;
        let selectedPeriod = $("#period-simulation-select-default").val() || "365";
        let isUpdatingFromSimulator_default = false;

        $('#period-simulation-select-default').on('change', async (e) => {
            selectedPeriod = $(e.target).val();
            valueSimulator = $("#period-simulation-input-default").maskMoney('unmasked')[0];
            if (!validateUserSimulation(selectedPeriod)) {
                return;
            }
            updateQuotationGraph(selectedPeriod);
            await simulationPeriod(valueSimulator, selectedPeriod);
        });

        $('#period-simulation-input-default').on('change keyup', async (e) => {
            valueSimulator = $("#period-simulation-input-default").maskMoney('unmasked')[0];
            selectedPeriod = $("#period-simulation-select-default").val();
            if (!validateUserSimulation(selectedPeriod)) {
                return;
            }
            await simulationPeriod(valueSimulator, selectedPeriod);
        });

        $('[id$="-selector-select"]').on("change", async function () {
            selectedPeriod = $("#period-simulation-select-default").val();
            valueSimulator = $("#period-simulation-input-default").maskMoney('unmasked')[0];
            let newCurrency = getCurrencySymbol();
            $("#period-simulation-input-default").maskMoney('destroy').maskMoney({
                prefix: formatMoneyDisplay(`${newCurrency} `),
                thousands: isPtBr ? '.' : ',',
                decimal: isPtBr ? ',' : '.',
                allowZero: true,
                affixesStay: true
            }).val(formatMoneyDisplay(`${newCurrency} ${formatMoney(valueSimulator, 2, isPtBr ? ',' : '.', isPtBr ? '.' : ',')}`));
            await simulationPeriod(valueSimulator, selectedPeriod);
        });

        $('#ticket-selector-select-commodity').on('change', async function() {
            selectedPeriod = $("#period-simulation-select-default").val();
            valueSimulator = $("#period-simulation-input-default").maskMoney('unmasked')[0];
            let newCurrency = getCurrencySymbol();
            $("#period-simulation-input-default").maskMoney('destroy').maskMoney({
                prefix: formatMoneyDisplay(`${newCurrency} `),
                thousands: isPtBr ? '.' : ',',
                decimal: isPtBr ? ',' : '.',
                allowZero: true,
                affixesStay: true
            }).val(formatMoneyDisplay(`${newCurrency} ${formatMoney(valueSimulator, 2, isPtBr ? ',' : '.', isPtBr ? '.' : ',')}`));
            await simulationPeriod(valueSimulator, selectedPeriod);
        });

        $('#' + periodScope).on('change', async function() {
            if (isUpdatingFromSimulator_default) {
                return;
            }

            let period = $(this).val();

            $('#period-simulation-select-default').closest('[x-data]')[0].dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('set-dropdown', {
                detail: {
                    value: period
                }
            }));

            valueSimulator = $("#period-simulation-input-default").maskMoney('unmasked')[0];
            await simulationPeriod(valueSimulator, period);
        });

        $('#usePayments').on('change', async function() {
            selectedPeriod = $("#period-simulation-select-default").val();
            valueSimulator = $("#period-simulation-input-default").maskMoney('unmasked')[0];
            await simulationPeriod(valueSimulator, selectedPeriod);
        });

        const simulationPeriod = async (value, days) => {
            const prices = await getPriceQuotations(days);
            let lastProfitability = (prices.lastPriceCotation.price / prices.firstPriceCotation.price) * 100 || 0;
            let result = (valueSimulator * lastProfitability) / 100 || 0;
            alternateValues(result, valueSimulator);
        };

        const alternateValues = (value, comparativeValue) => {
            let currentCurrency = getCurrencySymbol();
            let resultData = formatMoneyDisplay(`${isInternationalContext ? '$' : currentCurrency} ${formatMoney(isNaN(value) ? "-" : value, 2, ",", ".")}`);
            let colorResult = comparativeValue < value ? "tw-text-color-text-success-light" : "tw-text-color-text-error-light";

            $('#period-simulation-result-default')
                .removeClass("tw-text-color-text-success-light")
                .removeClass("tw-text-color-text-error-light")
                .addClass(colorResult);
            $('#period-simulation-result-default').html(resultData);

            $('#period-simulation-result-default-mobile')
                .removeClass("tw-text-color-text-success-light")
                .removeClass("tw-text-color-text-error-light")
                .addClass(colorResult);
            $('#period-simulation-result-default-mobile').html(resultData);
        };

        const getPriceQuotations = (days) => {
            let urlRequestQuotation;

                            if (days == 1 && !isCustomPeriodActive()) {
                    urlRequestQuotation = 'https://investidor10.com.br/api/quotations/one-day/CMIG4/';
                } else if (days == 7 && !isCustomPeriodActive()) {
                    urlRequestQuotation = 'https://investidor10.com.br/api/quotations/seven-days/CMIG4/';
                } else {
                                        let usePayments = ($('#usePayments').val() == 'adjusted');
                    urlRequestQuotation = urlQuotationBase + days + '/' + usePayments;
                                    }
            
            return $.get(urlRequestQuotation).then(function(data) {
                let selectedData;

                if (Array.isArray(data)) {
                    selectedData = data;
                } else {
                    let quotationType = 'real';
                    let currencySelector = $('[id$="-selector-select"]');
                    if (currencySelector.length > 0) {
                        let selectedValues = currencySelector.val();
                        if (selectedValues) {
                            quotationType = Array.isArray(selectedValues) ? (selectedValues[0] || 'real') : (selectedValues || 'real');
                        }
                    }
                    const normalizedQuotationType = quotationType === 'dollar' ? 'dolar' : quotationType;
                    selectedData = data[normalizedQuotationType] || data.dolar || data.dollar || data.real || [];
                }

                if (selectedData.length == 0) {
                    return {
                        firstPriceCotation: {
                            price: 0
                        },
                        lastPriceCotation: {
                            price: 0
                        }
                    };
                }

                const dynamicQuotationField = quotationVariable || getSelectedQuotationField();

                if (dynamicQuotationField) {
                    return {
                        firstPriceCotation: {
                            price: Number(selectedData[0][dynamicQuotationField] ?? selectedData[0].price)
                        },
                        lastPriceCotation: {
                            price: Number(selectedData[selectedData.length - 1][dynamicQuotationField] ?? selectedData[selectedData.length - 1].price)
                        }
                    };
                }

                let firstPriceCotation = selectedData[0];
                let lastPriceCotation = selectedData[selectedData.length - 1];
                return {
                    firstPriceCotation,
                    lastPriceCotation
                };
            });
        };

        const updateQuotationGraph = (selectedPeriod, triggerClick = true) => {
            if (String(selectedPeriod) === 'custom') {
                return;
            }

            const selectedText = $("#period-simulation-select-default").find("option:selected").text() ||
                $(`#period-simulation-select-default option[value='${selectedPeriod}']`).text();
            $('.simulation_period').html(selectedText);

            if (triggerClick) {
                const wasCustomPeriod = isCustomPeriodActive();
                clearCustomPeriod();
                isUpdatingFromSimulator_default = true;
                $(".period-quotation").removeClass('active');
                $(`.period-quotation[data-period=${selectedPeriod}]`).addClass('active');
                $periodBar().find('.segmented-period-bar__calendar-btn').removeClass('active');
                const select = $('#' + periodScope);
                if (wasCustomPeriod || String(select.val()) !== String(selectedPeriod)) {
                    select.val(selectedPeriod).trigger('change');
                }
                setTimeout(() => {
                    isUpdatingFromSimulator_default = false;
                }, 100);
            } else {
                $(".period-quotation").removeClass('active');
                $(`.period-quotation[data-period=${selectedPeriod}]`).addClass('active');
                $('#' + periodScope).val(selectedPeriod);
            }

            if (componentId !== 'default') {
                document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('periodSimulationSync', {
                    detail: {
                        source: componentId,
                        period: selectedPeriod
                    }
                }));
            }
        };

        const validateUserSimulation = (days) => {
            if (!days || Number(days) <= 1825) {
                return true;
            }
            return !restrict(userAuth, true);
        };

        if (componentId !== 'default') {
            document.addEventListener('periodSimulationSync', function(e) {
                if (e.detail.source === componentId) return;
                if ($('#period-simulation-select-default').closest('[x-data]').length) {
                    $('#period-simulation-select-default').closest('[x-data]')[0]
                        .dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('set-dropdown', {
                            detail: { value: e.detail.period }
                        }));
                }
            });
        }

        document.addEventListener('customPeriodSelected', async function(e) {
            if (e.detail.scope && e.detail.scope !== periodScope) return;
            let startDate = e.detail.startDate;
            let endDate = e.detail.endDate;
            let diffDays = Math.ceil((endDate - startDate) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
            if (diffDays < 1) diffDays = 1;

            let $select = $('#period-simulation-select-default');
            let customLabel = 'Personalizado';

            let $dropdown = $select.closest('[x-data]');
            if ($dropdown.length) {
                let customOption = $select.find('option[value="custom"]');
                if (!customOption.length) {
                    $select.append('<option value="custom">' + customLabel + '</option>');
                }
                $select.val('custom');
                $dropdown[0].dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('set-dropdown', {
                    detail: { value: 'custom', label: customLabel }
                }));
            }

            $(".period-quotation").removeClass('active');
            $periodBar().find('.segmented-period-bar__calendar-btn').addClass('active');

            valueSimulator = $("#period-simulation-input-default").maskMoney('unmasked')[0];
            await simulationPeriod(valueSimulator, diffDays.toString());
        });

        const $canonicalQuotation = $('#' + periodScope);
        if ($canonicalQuotation.length && $canonicalQuotation.val() && String($canonicalQuotation.val()) !== String(selectedPeriod)) {
            selectedPeriod = $canonicalQuotation.val();
            const $simDropdown = $('#period-simulation-select-default').closest('[x-data]');
            if ($simDropdown.length) {
                $simDropdown[0].dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('set-dropdown', {
                    detail: {
                        value: selectedPeriod
                    }
                }));
            }
        }

        simulationPeriod(valueSimulator, selectedPeriod);
    });
})();
</script>

<script>
    window.i10Currency = window.i10Currency || {
        byCode(currencyCode, isIntl) {
            const normalized = String(currencyCode || '').toLowerCase();
            if (normalized === 'dolar' || normalized === 'dollar' || normalized === 'usd') {
                return isIntl ? '$' : 'US$';
            }
            if (normalized === 'euro' || normalized === 'eur') {
                return '€';
            }
            if (normalized === 'bitcoins' || normalized === 'btc') {
                return 'BTC';
            }
            if (normalized === 'real' || normalized === 'brl') {
                return 'R$';
            }
            return isIntl ? '$' : 'R$';
        }
    };
</script>

<script>
    // Desktop: "?" em cada opção. Mobile: ícone ao lado (Alpine: clique / fora / scroll).
    (function initUsePaymentsSelect() {
        if (typeof window.$ === 'undefined' || !window.$.fn || !window.$.fn.select2) {
            return setTimeout(initUsePaymentsSelect, 60);
        }
        var $ = window.$;
        var $sel = $('#usePayments');
        if (!$sel.length || $sel.hasClass('select2-hidden-accessible')) {
            return;
        }

        var helpIcon = "<svg width=\"12\" height=\"12\" viewBox=\"0 0 12 12\" fill=\"none\" xmlns=\"http:\/\/www.w3.org\/2000\/svg\" aria-hidden=\"true\" focusable=\"false\"><circle cx=\"6\" cy=\"6\" r=\"5.0625\" stroke=\"currentColor\" stroke-width=\"1.125\"\/><path d=\"M4.62 4.74C4.78 3.96 5.41 3.5 6 3.5C6.75 3.5 7.35 4.05 7.35 4.8C7.35 5.42 6.96 5.87 6.42 6.22C5.88 6.57 5.68 6.94 5.68 7.38\" stroke=\"currentColor\" stroke-width=\"1.125\" stroke-linecap=\"round\"\/><circle cx=\"6\" cy=\"8.85\" r=\"0.5625\" fill=\"currentColor\"\/><\/svg>";
        var escapeHtml = function (value) {
            return $('<div>').text(value == null ? '' : String(value)).html();
        };
        var dsContent = function (title, body) {
            return '<div class="popover-ds">'
                + '<div class="popover-ds-header">' + escapeHtml(title) + '</div>'
                + '<div class="popover-ds-paragraph">' + escapeHtml(body) + '</div>'
                + '</div>';
        };
        var syncMobileTip = function () {
            var $opt = $sel.find('option:selected');
            $('#usePaymentsMobileTip').attr('data-content', dsContent($opt.text(), $opt.attr('data-tip') || ''));
        };

        $sel.select2({
            minimumResultsForSearch: -1,
            width: 'auto',
            templateResult: function (opt) {
                if (!opt.id) {
                    return opt.text;
                }
                var $row = $('<span class="up-opt"></span>')
                    .append($('<span class="up-opt-label"></span>').text(opt.text));
                var tip = $(opt.element).data('tip') || '';
                if (tip && !window.matchMedia('(max-width: 767px)').matches) {
                    $row.append(
                        $('<span class="ds-tooltip-trigger popover-trigger up-info"></span>')
                            .attr('data-popover-variant', 'ds')
                            .attr('data-content', dsContent(opt.text, tip))
                            .attr('data-time', '0')
                            .html(helpIcon)
                    );
                }
                return $row;
            }
        });

<script>
(function initIndexSimulatorMask() {
    if (typeof jQuery === 'undefined' || typeof $.fn.maskMoney === 'undefined') {
        setTimeout(initIndexSimulatorMask, 50);
        return;
    }

    if ($('#index-simulation-input').data('maskMoney-initialized')) return;

    const htmlLang = document.documentElement.lang || 'pt-br';
    const isPtBr = htmlLang.toLowerCase() === 'pt-br' || htmlLang.toLowerCase() === 'pt_br' || htmlLang.toLowerCase() === 'pt';
    const currency = window.isInternational ? '$' : 'R$';

    $("#index-simulation-input").maskMoney({
        prefix: formatMoneyDisplay(`${currency} `),
        thousands: isPtBr ? '.' : ',',
        decimal: isPtBr ? ',' : '.',
        allowZero: true,
        affixesStay: true
    }).maskMoney('mask').data('maskMoney-initialized', true);
})();

</script>

<script>
window.buildCompareIndexLegend = function (legend, benchmarkIndex) {
    benchmarkIndex = benchmarkIndex || 'CDI';

    var reordered = legend.slice();
    var benchmarkIdx = reordered.indexOf(benchmarkIndex);

    if (benchmarkIdx > 1) {
        reordered.splice(benchmarkIdx, 1);
        reordered.splice(1, 0, benchmarkIndex);
    }

    var selected = {};
    for (var i = 0; i < reordered.length; i++) {
        selected[reordered[i]] = i === 0 || reordered[i] === benchmarkIndex;
    }

    return {
        legend: reordered,
        selected: selected,
    };
};

window.getCompareChartTopSpacing = function () {
    if (screen.width < 400) {
        return 80;
    }

    if (screen.width < 600) {
        return 65;
    }

    return 50;
};
</script>
<script>
(function initCompareIndexPeriodSync() {
    if (typeof jQuery === 'undefined') {
        setTimeout(initCompareIndexPeriodSync, 50);
        return;
    }

    var $canonical = $('#period-profitabilities-select');
    var $simSelect = $('#index-simulation-select');
    if (!$canonical.length || !$simSelect.length) return;
    if ($canonical.data('compareSyncInit')) return;
    $canonical.data('compareSyncInit', true);

    var lastValidPeriod = String($canonical.val() || $simSelect.val() || '24');
    var syncing = false;

    var syncPillsState = function (value) {
        var v = String(value);
        var $indexSection = $('#compare-index-section');
        $indexSection.find('.period-profitabilities').removeClass('active');
        $indexSection.find('.period-profitabilities[data-period="' + v + '"]').addClass('active');
        if (String($canonical.val()) !== v) {
            $canonical.val(v);
        }
        var $mobile = $('#period-profitabilities-select-mobile');
        if ($mobile.length && String($mobile.val()) !== v) {
            $mobile.val(v);
            $mobile.data('previous-value', v);
            $mobile.trigger('change.select2');
        }
    };

    var syncSimulatorState = function (value) {
        var v = String(value);
        if (String($simSelect.val()) === v) return;
        var xDataEl = $simSelect.closest('[x-data]')[0];
        if (xDataEl) {
            xDataEl.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('set-dropdown', { detail: { value: v } }));
        }
    };

    var restrictsPeriod = function (period) {
        var isAuth = typeof userAuth !== 'undefined' ? userAuth : false;
        var isProUser = typeof userIsPro !== 'undefined' ? userIsPro : false;
        return Number(period) > 60 && (!isAuth || !isProUser);
    };

    var handlePeriodChange = function (newPeriod) {
        if (syncing) return;
        syncing = true;
        try {
            if (restrictsPeriod(newPeriod)) {
                syncPillsState(lastValidPeriod);
                syncSimulatorState(lastValidPeriod);
            } else {
                lastValidPeriod = String(newPeriod);
                syncPillsState(newPeriod);
                syncSimulatorState(newPeriod);
            }
        } finally {
            setTimeout(function () { syncing = false; }, 0);
        }
    };

    $canonical.on('change.compareSync', function () {
        var period = $(this).val();
        setTimeout(function () { handlePeriodChange(period); }, 0);
    });

    $simSelect.on('change.compareSync', function () {
        var period = $(this).val();
        setTimeout(function () { handlePeriodChange(period); }, 0);
    });
})();
</script>

            <h2 class="title">SOBRE A EMPRESA</h2>
            <div>
                <div class="read-more collapsed biography">
                    <div class="text-content">
                                                    <p>A <b>Companhia Energética de Minas Gerais S.A.</b> (<b><span style="font-size: 1rem;">Cemig</span><span style="font-size: 1rem;">&nbsp;</span></b><span style="font-size: 1rem;">)é uma empresa do setor de <a href="https://investidor10.com.br/setores/utilidade-publica" target="_blank">utilidade pública</a> e subsetor de <a href="https://investidor10.com.br/setores/utilidade-publica/energia-eletrica" target="_blank">energia eletrica</a>.</span></p><p>Atuando na geração, transmissão, distribuição e comercialização de energia elétrica, a Cemig atua no mercado de gás natural e energia renovável soluções energéticas sustentáveis e consultoria para eficiência energética.</p><p>Uma das maiores e mais tradicionais empresas do setor elétrico na América Latina, sua operação ocorre majoritariamente no Brasil, com forte presença no estado de Minas Gerais.&nbsp;</p><p>Entretanto, suas operações se expandem por várias regiões do país, e a empresa possui participações em ativos de energia em outros países da América Latina.</p><p>A empresa atua na geração, transmissão, distribuição e comercialização de energia elétrica, colaborando com empresas como a <a href="https://investidor10.com.br/acoes/petr4/" target="_blank">Petrobras</a>, Gasmig e a <a href="https://investidor10.com.br/acoes/taee11/" target="_blank">Taesa</a> fornecendo energia elétrica certificada.&nbsp;</p><p>Dessa forma, a companhia atende mais de 8,5 milhões de clientes e opera uma extensa rede de mais de 500 mil quilômetros de linhas de distribuição de energia.</p><p>Além disso, contabiliza mais de 60 usinas de geração, entre hidrelétricas, termoelétricas e parques solares, se consolidando como uma large cap.</p><p>Sua estrutura integrada abrange várias subsidiárias, além de participações em outras empresas, com participação direta e indireta em mais de 100 sociedades.</p><p>Na B3, a Cemig negocia suas ações sob o código <b>CMIG3 </b>e <b>CMIG4</b>, para o mercado fracionário, os códigos são CMIG3F e CMIG4F.</p><p>No mercado internacional, suas ações negociadas nas bolsas de Madri (<b>XCMIG</b>) e Nova Iorque (<b>CIG</b>)&nbsp;</p><h3>História e quando foi criada a Cemig&nbsp;</h3><p>Fundada em 1952 pelo então governador de Minas Gerais, Juscelino Kubitschek, a Companhia Energética de Minas Gerais surgiu com o objetivo de atender à crescente demanda por energia elétrica no estado.&nbsp;</p><p>Nos primeiros anos, a Cemig enfrentou o desafio de expandir a capacidade energética do estado de Minas Gerais para atender ao rápido crescimento industrial.</p><p>E em 1967 realizou a abertura de capital na bolsa brasileira, permitindo a expansão de suas operações.</p><p>Com a captação de recursos, a empresa pode realizar a construção de diversas hidrelétricas, atuando como uma das principais concessionárias de energia elétrica no país</p><p>Ao longo das décadas, expandiu suas operações adquirindo participações em empresas de energia de outros estados e países.</p><p>E nos últimos anos tem investido em gás natural e energias renováveis, como a solar e eólica.</p><p>Com investimento em hidrelétricas e energia solar, a empresa se empenha em projetos de modernização da rede elétrica, como a instalação de medidores inteligentes.</p>

                <div class="sub-especial margin-top-30" id="revenue-section" style="padding: 0 !important;">
    <div class="header">
        <span class="icon"><img src="https://investidor10.com.br/assets/front/images/line-graph.svg" alt="Cotação"></span>
        <h2>Regiões onde Cemig gera receita</h2>

<script>
    function setPrice(el) {
        const self = $(el);
        const buyLink = self.data('buy-link');
        let price = self.data('multiplier') * self.data('price');

        price = price.toFixed(2);
        price = price.replace('.', ',');
        // price = Number(price).toLocaleString('pt-BR');

        $('button.plan').removeClass('selected');
        self.addClass('selected');

        $('.subscribe .selected-price .price').text(price);
        $('.subscribe a.submit-subscribe').attr('href', buyLink);
    }
</script>

        var _activeNewsRequest = null;
    var _activeNewsPoll = null;
    
    var bestTickers = new Bloodhound({
      datumTokenizer: Bloodhound.tokenizers.obj.whitespace('simple-name'),
      queryTokenizer: Bloodhound.tokenizers.whitespace,
      remote: {
          url: '/api/component-list/layout.search.result-item?_source=search/%QUERY',
                    prepare: function(query, settings) {
              settings.url = '/api/component-list/layout.search.result-item?_source=search/' + encodeURIComponent(query);
              return settings;
          },
                    transform: function (data) {
                        return data.content;
                      },
                    cache: true,
          ttl: 86400000,
      }
  });

    var news = new Bloodhound({
    datumTokenizer: Bloodhound.tokenizers.obj.whitespace('simple-name'),
    queryTokenizer: Bloodhound.tokenizers.whitespace,
    remote: {
        url: '/api/search-news/%QUERY',
        prepare: function(query, settings) {
            settings._searchQuery = query;
            settings.url = '/api/search-news/' + encodeURIComponent(query);
            return settings;
        },
        transport: function(options, onSuccess, onError) {
            var query = options._searchQuery || '';

            if (_activeNewsPoll) {
                clearInterval(_activeNewsPoll);
                _activeNewsPoll = null;
            }
            if (_activeNewsRequest) {
                _activeNewsRequest.abort();
                _activeNewsRequest = null;
            }

            var checks = 0;
            var maxChecks = 40;
            _activeNewsPoll = setInterval(function() {
                var tickers = [];
                var assetsLoaded = false;
                var $input = $('.typeahead').filter(function() {
                    return $(this).val().length >= 3;
                }).first();

                if ($input.length) {
                    var $menu = $input.closest('.site-header--search, .search-destaque-home').find('.tt-menu');
                    if ($menu.length === 0) {
                        $menu = $input.siblings('.tt-menu');
                    }
                    var $assetsDataset = $menu.find('.tt-dataset-best-pictures');
                    if ($assetsDataset.find('.tt-suggestion').length > 0 || $assetsDataset.find('.empty-message').length > 0) {
                        assetsLoaded = true;
                    }
                    $assetsDataset.find('.tt-suggestion[data-ticker]').each(function() {
                        var ticker = $(this).data('ticker');
                        if (ticker && String(ticker).length >= 2 && tickers.indexOf(String(ticker)) === -1) {
                            tickers.push(String(ticker));
                        }
                    });
                }

                checks++;

                if (tickers.length > 0 || assetsLoaded || checks >= maxChecks) {
                    clearInterval(_activeNewsPoll);
                    _activeNewsPoll = null;

                    if (tickers.length > 0) {
                        options.url = options.url + '?tickers=' + encodeURIComponent(tickers.join(','));
                    }

                    _activeNewsRequest = $.ajax(options)
                        .done(function(data) {
                            _activeNewsRequest = null;
                            onSuccess([{ allNews: data }]);
                        })
                        .fail(function(jqXHR, textStatus) {
                            _activeNewsRequest = null;
                            if (textStatus !== 'abort') {
                                onSuccess([{ allNews: [] }]);
                            }
                        });
                }
            }, 50);
        },
        wildcard: '%QUERY',
        cache: false,
        ttl: 0,
    }
  });
  
  $('.typeahead').typeahead({
      minLength: 3,
      highlight: true

  (function() {
      var SELECTOR = '.tt-menu .item .info h3, .search-result-name, .search-result-ticker';
      var canHover = window.matchMedia('(hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)').matches;
      if (!canHover) {
          return;
      }

      var tip = null;

      function getTip() {
          if (!tip) {
              tip = document.createElement('div');
              tip.className = 'i10-truncate-tooltip';
              tip.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;z-index:100000;max-width:340px;padding:6px 10px;border-radius:6px;background:#2A2F38;color:#fff;font-size:12px;line-height:1.35;font-weight:400;box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(0,0,0,0.18);pointer-events:none;opacity:0;transition:opacity .08s ease;white-space:normal;word-break:break-word;';
              document.body.appendChild(tip);
          }
          return tip;
      }

      function hideTip() {
          if (tip) {
              tip.style.opacity = '0';
          }
      }

      function showTip(el, text) {
          var t = getTip();
          t.textContent = text;
          t.style.opacity = '0';
          t.style.display = 'block';
          var r = el.getBoundingClientRect();
          var top = r.top - t.offsetHeight - 6;
          if (top < 4) {
              top = r.bottom + 6;
          }
          var left = r.left;
          if (left + t.offsetWidth > window.innerWidth - 8) {
              left = window.innerWidth - t.offsetWidth - 8;
          }
          if (left < 8) {
              left = 8;
          }
          t.style.top = top + 'px';
          t.style.left = left + 'px';
          t.style.opacity = '1';
      }

      document.addEventListener('mouseover', function(e) {
          var el = e.target.closest ? e.target.closest(SELECTOR) : null;
          if (!el) {
              return;
          }
          if (el.scrollWidth <= el.clientWidth) {
              hideTip();
              return;
          }
          showTip(el, el.getAttribute('data-full-name') || el.textContent.trim());
      });

      document.addEventListener('mouseout', function(e) {
          if (e.target.closest && e.target.closest(SELECTOR)) {
              hideTip();
          }
      });

      window.addEventListener('scroll', hideTip, true);
  })();

  $('.typeahead').bind('typeahead:asyncrequest', function(ev, suggestion) {
      $('.site-header--search .ti-reload, .search-destaque-home .ti-reload').show();
      var $menu = $(this).closest('.site-header--search, .search-destaque-home').find('.tt-menu');
      if ($menu.length === 0) {
          $menu = $(this).siblings('.tt-menu');
      }
      $menu.removeClass('open');
      $menu.find('.tt-dataset').hide();
  });

  $('.typeahead').bind('typeahead:asyncreceive', function(ev, suggestion) {
      $('.site-header--search .ti-reload, .search-destaque-home .ti-reload').hide();
      var $menu = $(this).closest('.site-header--search, .search-destaque-home').find('.tt-menu');
      if ($menu.length === 0) {
          $menu = $(this).siblings('.tt-menu');
      }
      var hasResults = $menu.find('.tt-suggestion').length > 0;
      if (hasResults) {
          $menu.addClass('open');
          $menu.find('.tt-dataset').show();
                    var $newsDataset = $menu.find('.tt-dataset-news');
          if ($newsDataset.length && $newsDataset.find('.tt-suggestion').length === 0) {
              $newsDataset.html(
                  '<div class="tt-suggestion related-news" style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px;width:100%;min-height:380px;padding:8px;border-radius:8px;border:0.5px solid #E3E6ED;background:#F5F5F4;overflow:hidden;">' +
                      '<div class="title" style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;flex-shrink:0;">' +
                          '<img src="/assets/front/general-icons/news-icon.svg" alt="" style="width:20px;height:20px;">' +
                          '<p style="font-size:16px;font-weight:600;margin:0;">Notícias relacionadas</p>' +
                      '</div>' +
                      '<div class="news-content" style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;flex:1;justify-content:center;align-items:center;">' +
                          '<div style="width:20px;height:20px;border:3px solid #E3E6ED;border-top-color:#666;border-radius:50%;animation:spin .8s linear infinite;"></div>' +
                      '</div>' +
                  '</div>'
              ).show();
          }
                } else {
          $menu.removeClass('open');
      }
  });

  $('.typeahead').bind('typeahead:close', function(ev, suggestion) {
      $('.tt-menu').removeClass('open');
  });

  $('.typeahead').on('input', function() {
      if ($(this).val().length < 3) {
          $(this).siblings('.tt-menu').removeClass('open');
      }
  });
</script>

                event.preventDefault();

                const ref = $(this).data('ref');

                if (!ref) {
                    return;
                }

                const $target = $(ref);

                if (!$target.length) {
                    return;

                    scrollTop: $target.offset().top - siteHeaderHeight - stickyNavHeight - 8
                }, 500);
            });

        let data_indicator_history = '';

        let _sectorIndicators = null;

        const INDICATOR_ANOMALY_MIN = -100;
        const INDICATOR_ANOMALY_MAX = 100;
        const INDICATOR_ANOMALY_PCT_THRESHOLD = 0.2;

        const isInternationalContext = false;

        const isIndicatorAnomalyValue = (val) => {
            const n = parseFloat(val);
            return isNaN(n) ? false : (n < INDICATOR_ANOMALY_MIN || n > INDICATOR_ANOMALY_MAX);
        };

        const applyIndicatorAnomalyFilter = (data) => {
            if (!data || data.length === 0) return data;
            const lastIndex = data.length - 1;
            const anomalyCount = data.slice(0, lastIndex).filter(d => isIndicatorAnomalyValue(d.value)).length;
            if (anomalyCount / data.length > INDICATOR_ANOMALY_PCT_THRESHOLD) return data;
            return data.filter((d, i) => i === lastIndex || !isIndicatorAnomalyValue(d.value));
        };

        const formatIndicatorValue = (value, type) => {
            if (typeof formatIndicatorChartValue === 'function') {
                return formatIndicatorChartValue(value, type);
            }

            const numericValue = parseFloat(value) || 0;
            if (type === 'percent') {
                return typeof formatMoney === 'function'
                    ? `${formatMoney(numericValue)}%`
                    : `${numericValue.toFixed(2).replace('.', ',')}%`;
            }

            if (typeof numberAbbreviation === 'function') {
                return numberAbbreviation(numericValue).trim();
            }

            return numericValue.toFixed(2).replace('.', ',');
        };

        const updateIndicatorBoxValues = (rawDataApiOrder, chartData) => {
            if (!rawDataApiOrder || rawDataApiOrder.length === 0) {
                $('#current-value').text('0,00');
                $('#company-average-value').text('0,00');
                $('#sector-average-value').text('0,00');
                return;
            }

            const indicatorData = rawDataApiOrder[0];
            if (!indicatorData || indicatorData.value === null || indicatorData.value === undefined) {
                $('#current-value').text('0,00');
                $('#company-average-value').text('0,00');
                $('#sector-average-value').text('0,00');
                return;
            }

            const currentValue = (_indicatorCurrentValueOverride !== null && _indicatorCurrentValueOverride !== undefined)
                ? parseFloat(_indicatorCurrentValueOverride)
                : (parseFloat(indicatorData.value) || 0);
            const dataForAvg = chartData && chartData.length > 0 ? chartData : rawDataApiOrder;
            const average = dataForAvg.reduce((acc, item) => acc + (parseFloat(item.value) || 0), 0) / dataForAvg.length;

            $('#current-value').text(formatIndicatorValue(currentValue, indicatorData.type));
            $('#company-average-value').text(formatIndicatorValue(average, indicatorData.type));

        $(function ($) {
            $.fn.select2.amd.require([
                'select2/selection/single',
                'select2/selection/placeholder',
                'select2/selection/allowClear',
                'select2/dropdown',
                'select2/dropdown/attachBody',
                'select2/utils'
            ], function (SingleSelection, Placeholder, AllowClear, Dropdown, AttachBody, Utils) {

                var SelectionAdapter = Utils.Decorate(
                    SingleSelection,
                    Placeholder
                );

                SelectionAdapter = Utils.Decorate(
                    SelectionAdapter,
                    AllowClear
                );

                var DropdownAdapter = Utils.Decorate(
                    Dropdown,
                    AttachBody
                );

                var base_element = $('.select2-multiple2')
                if (!base_element.length) return;
                $(base_element).select2({
                    placeholder: 'Cotações em',
                    selectionAdapter: SelectionAdapter,
                    dropdownAdapter: DropdownAdapter,
                    allowClear: false,
                    minimumResultsForSearch: Infinity,
                    templateResult: function (data) {
                        if (!data.id) {
                            return data.text;
                        }
                        var $res = $('<div></div>');
                        $res.text(data.text);
                        $res.addClass('wrap');
                        return $res;
                    },
                    templateSelection: function (data) {
                        if (!data.id) {
                            return data.text;
                        }
                        var selected = ($(base_element).val() || []).length;
                        var total = $('option', $(base_element)).length;
                        thatQuotation = $(base_element).val();
                        lastSelected = thatQuotation.filter(x => !lastQuotation.includes(x));
                        lastQuotation = thatQuotation;

                        const selectedOptions = thatQuotation || [];
                        if (selectedOptions.length == 0) return "Cotações em";
                        const selectedLabels = selectedOptions.map(x => {
                            const currencies = {
                                'real': 'Real',
                                'dolar': 'Dólar',
                                'euro': 'Euro',
                            }
                            return currencies[x] || x
                        })

                        return selectedLabels.join(", ")
                    }
                });
            });
        });

                return (new Intl.NumberFormat('pt-BR', {style: 'currency', currency: 'BRL'}).format(number));

            function abbreviateNumber(number, precision = 2) {
                number = Math.abs(number)
                decPlaces = Math.pow(10, precision);
                var abbrev = ["K", "M", "B", "T"];
                for (var i = abbrev.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
                    var size = Math.pow(10, (i + 1) * 3);
                    if (size <= number) {
                        number = Math.round(number * decPlaces / size) / decPlaces;
                        if ((number == 1000) && (i < abbrev.length - 1)) {
                            number = 1;
                            i++;
                        }
                        number += abbrev[i];
                        break;
                    }
                }
                return number;
            }

                        const calculateMinMax = (dataArray) => {

                            const range = maxPrice - minPrice;
                            let calcMin, calcMax;

                            if (range < minPrice * 0.15) {
                                const padding = range * 0.10;
                                calcMin = minPrice - padding;
                                calcMax = maxPrice + padding;
                            } else {
                                calcMin = minPrice * 0.98;
                                calcMax = maxPrice * 1.02;
                            }

                            return {
                                min: Number(calcMin).toFixed(6),
                                max: Number(calcMax).toFixed(6)
                            };
                        };

                            const chartElement = document.getElementById('chart-quotation');
                            if (chartElement) {
                                const rect = chartElement.getBoundingClientRect();
                                const isOutOfView = rect.bottom < 0 || rect.top > window.innerHeight;

                                if (isOutOfView) {

                                        type: 'brush',

                        quotationChart.on('brush', function (params) {
                            brushActive = !!(params.areas && params.areas.length > 0);

                            let tooltipEl = document.getElementById('brush-tooltip');
                            if (!tooltipEl) {
                                tooltipEl = document.createElement('div');
                                tooltipEl.id = 'brush-tooltip';
                                tooltipEl.style.cssText = 'position: fixed; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.85); color: white; padding: 12px 16px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid #A07D45; font-size: 11px; display: none; z-index: 1000; pointer-events: none; text-align: center; min-width: 200px; box-shadow: 0 4px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);';
                                document.body.appendChild(tooltipEl);
                            }

                            if (params.areas && params.areas.length > 0) {
                                const area = params.areas[0];

                                if (area.coordRange && area.coordRange.length >= 2) {
                                    const startIndex = Math.max(0, Math.floor(area.coordRange[0]));
                                    const endIndex = Math.min(dates.length - 1, Math.floor(area.coordRange[1]));

                                    if (startIndex !== endIndex && endIndex > startIndex && dates && series && series[0]) {
                                        const startValue = series[0].data[startIndex];
                                        const endValue = series[0].data[endIndex];

                                        if (startValue !== undefined && endValue !== undefined) {
                                            const variation = endValue - startValue;
                                            const variationPercent = startValue !== 0 ? ((endValue / startValue - 1) * 100).toFixed(2) : 0;
                                            const variationSign = variation >= 0 ? '+' : '';
                                            const variationColor = variation >= 0 ? '#28a745' : '#dc3545';

                                            let symbol = 'R$';
                                            if (series[0].name === '$' || series[0].name === 'US$') symbol = series[0].name;
                                            else if (series[0].name === '€') symbol = '€';
                                            else if (series[0].name === 'BTC') symbol = 'BTC';

                                            const tooltipContent = `
                                                <div style="text-align: center; line-height: 1.4;">
                                                    <div style="font-size: 11px; margin-bottom: 6px;"><strong>${dates[startIndex]} - ${dates[endIndex]}</strong></div>
                                                    <div style="font-size: 10px; margin-bottom: 10px; color: #ddd;">${symbol} ${numberAbbreviation(startValue, true)} → ${symbol} ${numberAbbreviation(endValue, true)}</div>
                                                    <div style="font-size: 22px; font-weight: bold; color: ${variationColor}; line-height: 1.1; margin-bottom: 4px;">
                                                        ${variationSign}${variationPercent}%
                                                    </div>
                                                    <div style="font-size: 9px; color: #bbb;">
                                                        ${variationSign}${symbol} ${numberAbbreviation(Math.abs(variation), true)}
                                                    </div>
                                                </div>
                                            `;

                                            tooltipEl.innerHTML = tooltipContent;
                                            tooltipEl.style.display = 'block';

                                            const chartDom = document.getElementById('chart-quotation');
                                            const chartRect = chartDom.getBoundingClientRect();
                                            const brushArea = params.areas[0];

                                            if (brushArea && brushArea.coordRange) {
                                                const startPercent = brushArea.coordRange[0] / dates.length;
                                                const endPercent = brushArea.coordRange[1] / dates.length;
                                                const centerPercent = (startPercent + endPercent) / 2;
                                                const leftPosition = chartRect.left + (chartRect.width * centerPercent) + 20;

                                                tooltipEl.style.left = leftPosition + 'px';
                                                tooltipEl.style.top = (chartRect.top - 90) + 'px';
                                                tooltipEl.style.transform = 'translateX(-50%)';
                                            } else {
                                                const chartCenter = chartRect.left + (chartRect.width / 2) + 20;
                                                tooltipEl.style.left = chartCenter + 'px';
                                                tooltipEl.style.top = (chartRect.top - 90) + 'px';
                                                tooltipEl.style.transform = 'translateX(-50%)';

                                }

                            }

                                $('#brush-tooltip').hide();
                            }
                        });

                        thatQuotation = $(base_element).val();
                        let itemTicker = $("#item-ticker-selector");

                        if ($(thatQuotation).size() == 2) {
                            itemTicker.addClass('margin-bottom-20');
                        } else if ($(thatQuotation).size() == 1) {
                            itemTicker.removeClass('margin-bottom-20');
                        }

                        $(".loading-quotation").hide()
                        return true;
                    }
                    firstPriceCotation = [];
                    lastPriceCotation = [];
                    $(".loading-quotation, #chart-quotation").hide()
                    $("#chart-quotation").parent().append('<div id="chart-quotation-msg" class="text-center" style="padding: 60px; font-size: 1.4rem; text-transform: uppercase; color: #5f5f5f; font-weight: lighter;">Não há dados de cotação para o período selecionado</div>')

                }).always(() => {
                    $(".loading-quotation").hide();
                });

                                let year = "";
                                n.forEach(function (n) {
                                    year = n.name.substring(0, 4);
                                    quarter = n.name.substring(4, 5);
                                    let titleText = `${quarter}T${year}`
                                    if (quarter === "0" || quarter === "") {
                                        titleText = year;
                                    }

                                    if (n.name[0] === 'Ú') {
                                        titleText = n.name;
                                    }

                                    year = `<span style="display:block;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;line-height:13pt; text-align: center">${titleText}</span>`;
                                    text += `<span style="display:flex; align-items: center;">
                                            <span style="display:block; width:10px; height:10px; margin-right: 5px; padding:1px; border-radius:10px; background-color:${n.color}"></span>
                                            <span style="display:block; margin-top:5px">
                                                <span style="display:block; font-size:8pt;line-height:9pt">${n.seriesName.toUpperCase()}:</span>
                                                <span style="display:block;font-weight: bold; font-size:9pt; line-height:10pt">R$ ${numberAbbreviation(n.value, true)}</span>
                                            </span>
                                        </span>`
                                });
                                return `<div style="padding: 10px"> ${year + text}</div>`;
                            }

                                smooth: true,
                                name: 'Receita Líquida',

                                formatter: function (n) {
                                    let year = n.substring(0, 4);
                                    let quarter = n.substring(4, 5);
                                    let text = `${quarter}T${year}`
                                    if (quarter === "0" || quarter === "") {
                                        text = year;
                                    }

                                    if (n[0] === 'Ú') {
                                        return n;

                                    return text

            const getJsonBalanceSheet = (yearly = false) => {
                $("#loading-balance-sheet").show()
                $.get('/api/balancos/balancopatrimonial/chart/41/' + yearly + '/').done(function (data) {
                    let html = '';
                    const indexAV = [];
                    const indexAH = [];
                    $.each(data, (items_key, items) => {

                        if (items_key === 4) {
                            html += '<tr>';

                            $.each(items, (key, item) => {

                                let classColumn = 'column-value';

                                if (indexAV.includes(key)) {
                                    classColumn = 'column-av d-none';
                                }

                                if (indexAH.includes(key)) {
                                    classColumn = 'column-ah d-none';
                                }

                                html += `<td class="${classColumn}">&nbsp;</td>`;
                            });
                        }

                        html += '<tr>';

                        $.each(items, (key, item) => {
                            if (item === 'AV %') {
                                indexAV.push(key)
                            }

                            if (item === 'AH %') {
                                indexAH.push(key)
                            }

                            let classColumn = 'column-value';

                            if (indexAV.includes(key)) {
                                classColumn = 'column-av d-none';
                            }

                            if (indexAH.includes(key)) {
                                classColumn = 'column-ah d-none';
                            }

                            if (Array.isArray(item)) {
                                item = '<div class="simple-value">' + item[0] + '</div><div class="detail-value">' + item[1] + '</div>'
                            }

                            html += items_key === 0 ? `<th class="${classColumn}">${item}</th>` : `<td class="${classColumn}">${item}</td>`;
                        });
                        html += '</tr>';

                    });
                    $("#table-balance-sheet").html(html)
                    $("#loading-balance-sheet").hide()

                });
            }

            const getJsonBalanceResults = (period = 5, category = 'yearly') => {
                $("#loading-balance-results").show()
                $.get(`/api/balancos/balancoresultados/chart/41/${period}/${category}` + '/').done(function (data) {
                    let html = '';
                    const indexAV = [];
                    const indexAH = [];
                    $.each(data, (items_key, items) => {
                        html += '<tr>';
                        $.each(items, (key, item) => {
                            if (item === 'AV %') {
                                indexAV.push(key)
                            }

                            if (item === 'AH %') {
                                indexAH.push(key)
                            }

                            let classColumn = 'column-value';

                            if (indexAV.includes(key)) {
                                classColumn = 'column-av d-none';
                            }

                            if (indexAH.includes(key)) {
                                classColumn = 'column-ah d-none';
                            }

                            if (Array.isArray(item)) {
                                item = '<div class="simple-value">' + item[0] + '</div><div class="detail-value">' + item[1] + '</div>'
                            }

                            if (items_key > 0 && key === 0 && item !== '#' && item !== 'AV %' && item !== 'AH %') {
                                const fieldName = item.replace(/<[^>]*>/g, '').trim();
                                item = `${item} <a href="javascript:void(0)" class="balance-history-graph" data-field="${fieldName}"><i class="fas fa-chart-area"></i></a>`;
                            }

                            html += items_key === 0 ? `<th class="${classColumn}">${item}</th>` : `<td class="${classColumn}">${item}</td>`;
                        });
                        html += '</tr>';

                    });
                    $("#table-balance-results").html(html)
                    $("#loading-balance-results").hide()
                });
            }

                    function getSelectedSeries(myChart) {
                        const option = myChart.getOption();
                        let selected = {};

                        if (option && option.legend && option.legend[0] && option.legend[0].selected) {
                            selected = option.legend[0].selected;

                        return selected;

                    // Função para definir o estado das séries selecionadas
                    function setSelectedSeries(myChart, selected) {
                        const option = myChart.getOption();

                        if (option && option.legend && option.legend[0]) {
                            option.legend[0].selected = selected;
                            myChart.setOption(option);
                        }

                        }

                        // Extrair os quarters, assumindo que todos são iguais. Pegando de AVG, pois é o unico item que podemos ter certeza que sempre existirá no array de objetos.
                        var quarters = data["AVG"].map(item => item.quarter);

                        var series = [];
                        var legendData = [];
                        var firstItemKey = Object.keys(data)[0];

                        series.push({
                            name: firstItemKey,
                            type: 'line',
                            data: data[firstItemKey].map(item => parseFloat(item.value)),
                            selected: true
                        });
                        legendData.push(firstItemKey);

                        series.push({
                            name: 'MÉDIA DO SETOR',

                            data: data['AVG'].map(item => parseFloat(item.value)),
                            selected: true
                        });
                        legendData.push('MÉDIA DO SETOR');

                        for (var key in data) {

                                    name: key,
                                    type: 'line',
                                    data: data[key].map(item => item.value ? parseFloat(item.value) : null),
                                    selected: false
                                });
                                legendData.push(key);
                            }
                        }

                        var minValue = Math.min(...Object.values(data).flat().map(item => item.value !== null ? parseFloat(item.value) : 20));
                        var maxValue = Math.max(...Object.values(data).flat().map(item => item.value !== null ? parseFloat(item.value) : item.value));

                                            return;

                    `

                        });

                        content += `</tr>`
                        start = true;

                    });

                    thead += '</tr>';

                    html = thead + content;

                    $("#table-indicators-history").html(html)
                    $("#loading-indicators-history").hide()
                });
