            var compareChart = echarts.init(document.getElementById('chart-profitability'));
            let lastProfitabilityCompare = JSON.parse(`{"CMIG4":{"value":131.8,"type":"Ticker"},"CDI":{"value":80.92,"type":"CdiQuotation"},"IPCA":{"value":27.87,"type":"Ipca"},"IBOV":{"value":79.19,"type":"Index"},"SMLL":{"value":-2.95,"type":"Index"},"IFIX":{"value":43.64,"type":"Index"},"IDIV":{"value":111.65,"type":"Index"},"IVVB11":{"value":64.87,"type":"Etf"}}`);
            let qtop = typeof getCompareChartTopSpacing === 'function' ? getCompareChartTopSpacing() : 50;
            let cleft = '1%';
            let cright = '1%';
            if (screen.width < 600) {
                cleft = 0;
                cright = 0;
            }

            const compareLegendConfig = buildCompareIndexLegend(legend5);
            const selected = compareLegendConfig.selected;
            const legendData = compareLegendConfig.legend;

            quotationOption = {
                grid: {
                    left: cleft,
                    top: qtop,
                    right: cright,
                    bottom: 25,
                    containLabel: true,
                    borderColor: "#f00"
                },
                xAxis: {
                    type: 'category',
                    boundaryGap: true,
                    data: withRightAlignedLastLabel(dates5),
                    axisLabel: { color: "#778698" },
                    axisLine: { lineStyle: { color: "#E3E6ED" } },
                },
                legend: {
                    data: legendData,
                    selected
                },
                yAxis: {
                    type: 'value',
                    axisLabel: {
                        formatter: function (value) {
                            return trimZeroDecimals(numberAbbreviation(value, false, true)) + '%'
                        },
                        color: "#778698",
                    },
                    splitLine: { lineStyle: { color: '#F5F6F7' } },
                    axisLine: { lineStyle: { color: "#E3E6ED" } },
                },
                tooltip: {
                    trigger: "axis",
                    axisPointer: {
                        type: "cross",
                        animation: !1,
                        label: {
                            backgroundColor: "#ccc",
                            borderColor: "#aaa",
                            borderWidth: 1,
                            shadowBlur: 0,
                            shadowOffsetX: 0,
                            shadowOffsetY: 0,
                            textStyle: {
                                color: "#222"
                            }
                        }
                    },
                    formatter: function (n) {
                        let html = '';
                        let name = '';

                        n.forEach((i, a) => {
                            name = `<p style="color: white"><strong>${i.name}</strong></p>`;

                            if (i.value[3] == 'index') {
                                let points = parseFloat(i.value[2]).toLocaleString('pt-BR', {
                                    minimumFractionDigits: 2,
                                    maximumFractionDigits: 2
                                });
                                var price = `(${points})`
                            } else {
                                var price = `(R$ ${numberAbbreviation(i.value[2], true)})`
                            }

                            html += `<div class='d-flex align-items-center'>
                                <span style="width:10px; height:10px;margin-right: 5px; padding:1px;border-radius:10px; background-color:${i.color}"></span>
                                <div>${i.seriesName}: <strong>${numberAbbreviation(i.value[1], false)}%</strong></div>
                            </div>`;
                        })

                        return name + html;
                    }
                },
                series: series5,
            };
            compareChart.setOption(quotationOption);

            const simulator_compare = () => {
                let html = '';
                // Read value from index simulator input if available, fallback to global
                if ($('#index-simulation-input').length && $('#index-simulation-input').data('maskMoney-initialized')) {
                    let unmasked = $("#index-simulation-input").maskMoney('unmasked');
                    if (unmasked && unmasked[0]) {
                        valueSimulator = unmasked[0];
                    }
                }
                valueSimulator = parseFloat(valueSimulator);

                const simCurrency = indexSimIsPtBr ? 'R$' : '$';
                const simThousands = indexSimIsPtBr ? '.' : ',';
                const simDecimal = indexSimIsPtBr ? ',' : '.';
                const txtIn = 'em';
                const txtYouWouldHave = 'você teria';

                let j = 0;
                let mainTickerResult = 0;
                Object.keys(lastProfitabilityCompare).forEach((i, e) => {
                    let result = (valueSimulator * lastProfitabilityCompare[i].value) / 100;
                    result = valueSimulator + result;
                    let button = "";

                    if (j === 0) {
                        button = `<a href="/acoes/${i.toLowerCase()}/" class="action">${i}</a>`;
                        mainTickerResult = result;
                    } else if (i === 'IVVB11') {
                        button = `<a href="/etfs/${i.toLowerCase()}/" class="action">${i}</a>`;
                    } else {
                        button = `<a href="/indices/${i.toLowerCase()}/" class="action">${i}</a>`;
                    }

                    html += `<p>${button}<span class="desktop"> ${simCurrency} ${formatMoney(valueSimulator, 2, simDecimal, simThousands)} ${txtIn} ${i} ${txtYouWouldHave} </span><span class="valor">${simCurrency} ${formatMoney(result, 2, simDecimal, simThousands)}</span></p>`;
                    j++;
                });
                $("#simulators_compare").html(html);

                // Update simulator result display
                let resultText = `${simCurrency} ${formatMoney(mainTickerResult, 2, simDecimal, simThousands)}`;
                let colorClass = mainTickerResult >= valueSimulator ? 'tw-text-color-text-success-light' : 'tw-text-color-text-error-light';
                $('#index-simulation-result, #index-simulation-result-mobile')
                    .removeClass('tw-text-color-text-success-light tw-text-color-text-error-light')
                    .addClass(colorClass)
                    .html(resultText);
            }

            simulator_compare();

            // Index simulator: input value change -> recalculate
            $('#index-simulation-input').on('change keyup', function () {
                simulator_compare();
            });

            // Index simulator: dropdown change -> sync period buttons + chart
            let indexSimSyncFromButton = false;
            $('#index-simulation-select').on('change', function () {
                if (indexSimSyncFromButton) return;
                let period = $(this).val();

                if (period > 60 && restrict(userAuth, userIsPro)) {
                    return;
                }

                $("#compare-index-section .period-profitabilities").removeClass('active');
                $('#compare-index-section .period-profitabilities[data-period=' + period + ']').addClass('active');
                $("#period-profitabilities-select").val(period).trigger('change');
            });

            const getJsonQuotationProfit = (adjusted) => {
                $.getJSON(`/api/cotacao-lucro/cmig4/${adjusted}/`).done(function (data) {
                    let quotations = [];
                    let profit = [];
                    let years = [];

                    $.each(data, (key, item) => {
                        quotations.push(item.quotation)
                        years.push(key);
                        profit.push(item.net_profit);
                    });

                    var quotationProfitGraph = echarts.init(document.getElementById('graph-quotation-profit-' + adjusted));

                    let qmargin = 80;
                    let qcontainLabel = false;
                    if (screen.width < 600) {
                        // 35px fixos não cabiam rótulos como "7,91B" e cortavam o
                        // primeiro dígito. Com containLabel o ECharts reserva a
                        // largura real de cada eixo.
                        qmargin = 0;
                        qcontainLabel = true;
                    }

                    // Limites dos eixos. No mobile eles são arredondados para que
                    // nenhum rótulo precise de casa decimal — o min/max cru sai de
                    // um multiplicador (0.8 / 1.05) e cai em valores como 2,58 e
                    // 16,44B, que apareciam no eixo.
                    const qpCotacaoMin = Math.min(...quotations) * 0.8;
                    const qpCotacaoMax = Math.max(...quotations) * 1.05;
                    const qpLucroMax = Math.max(...profit) * 1.05;
                    const qpBounds = (screen.width < 600)
                        ? {
                            cotacao: snapAxisBounds(qpCotacaoMin, qpCotacaoMax),
                            lucro: snapAxisBounds(0, qpLucroMax),
                        }
                        : {
                            cotacao: { min: qpCotacaoMin.toFixed(2), max: qpCotacaoMax.toFixed(2) },
                            lucro: { max: qpLucroMax.toFixed(2) },
                        };

                    quotationProfitGraphOption = {
                        baseOption: {
                            animationDuration: 300,
                            grid: {
                                left: qmargin,
                                top: 40,
                                right: qmargin,
                                bottom: 25,
                                containLabel: qcontainLabel,
                                borderColor: "#f00"
                            },
                            xAxis: {
                                type: 'category',
                                boundaryGap: true,
                                data: years,
                                axisLabel: { color: "#778698" },
                                axisLine: { lineStyle: { color: "#E3E6ED" } },
                            },
                            legend: {
                                data: ['Lucro Líquido', 'Cotação']
                            },
                            yAxis: [
                                {
                                    type: 'value',
                                    minInterval: 0.01,
                                    min: qpBounds.cotacao.min,
                                    max: qpBounds.cotacao.max,
                                    position: 'right',
                                    axisLabel: {
                                        formatter: function (value) {
                                            if (screen.width < 600) {
                                                return trimZeroDecimals(numberAbbreviation(value, true, true));
                                            }
                                            return 'R$' + numberAbbreviation(value, true)
                                        },
                                        color: "#778698",
                                    },
                                    splitLine: { lineStyle: { color: '#F5F6F7' } },
                                    axisLine: { lineStyle: { color: "#E3E6ED" } },
                                },
                                {
                                    type: 'value',
                                    position: 'left',
                                    minInterval: 0.01,
                                    max: qpBounds.lucro.max,
                                    axisLabel: {
                                        formatter: function (value) {
                                            if (screen.width < 600) {
                                                return trimZeroDecimals(numberAbbreviation(value, false, true));
                                            }
                                            return 'R$' + numberAbbreviation(value)
                                        },
                                        color: "#778698",
                                    },
                                    splitLine: { lineStyle: { color: '#F5F6F7' } },
                                    axisLine: { lineStyle: { color: "#E3E6ED" } },
                                },
                            ],
                            tooltip: {
                                trigger: "axis",
                                axisPointer: {
                                    type: "shadow"
                                },
                                formatter: function (n) {
                                    let text = "";
                                    let year = "";
                                    n.forEach(function (n) {
                                        year = `<span style="display:block;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;line-height:13pt; text-align: center">${n.name}</span>`;
                                        text += `<span style="display:flex; align-items: center;">
                                                <span style="display:block; width:10px; height:10px; margin-right: 5px; padding:1px; border-radius:10px; background-color:${n.color}"></span>
                                                <span style="display:block; margin-top:5px">
                                                    <span style="display:block; font-size:8pt;line-height:9pt">${n.seriesName.toUpperCase()}:</span>
                                                    <span style="display:block;font-weight: bold; font-size:9pt; line-height:10pt">R$ ${numberAbbreviation(n.value, true)}</span>
                                                </span>
                                            </span>`
                                    });
                                    return `<div style="padding: 10px"> ${year + text}</div>`;
                                }
                            },
                            series: [
                                {
                                    name: 'Cotação',
                                    type: 'line',
                                    sampling: 'average',
                                    itemStyle: {
                                        color: '#A38C65',
                                        fontStyle: 'bolder',
                                    },
                                    smooth: true,
                                    data: quotations,
                                    label: {
                                        show: false,
                                        position: 'top',
                                        color: '#A38C65',
                                    },
                                },
                                {
                                    name: 'Lucro Líquido',
                                    type: 'line',
                                    sampling: 'average',
                                    itemStyle: {
                                        color: '#0d9066',
                                        fontStyle: 'bolder',
                                    },
                                    yAxisIndex: 1,
                                    smooth: true,
                                    data: profit,
                                    label: {
                                        show: false,
                                        position: 'top',
                                        color: '#A38C65',
                                    },
                                }
                            ]
                        },
                    };
                    quotationProfitGraph.setOption(quotationProfitGraphOption);
                });
            }

        function filterDataForm(filterValueSelected) {
            let filterParam = 'companies='+41;

            if (filterValueSelected) {
                filterParam += '&'+filterValueSelected;
            }

            $.ajax({
                url: `/api/acoes/dividends-map`,
                type: 'GET',
                dataType: 'json',
                headers: {
                    'X-CSRF-TOKEN': '1OvhvnwTxiprEJ3jne1FwT9MyFcc46pZUTqNELIV',
                    'Accept': 'application/json',
                },
                data: {
                    'filter': filterParam,
                    'showMoreResults': true
                },
                success: function (data) {
                    $('#container-cards-dividends').html(data.dividendsCards);

                    if ($('#empty-result').length > 0) {
                        $('#radar-dividends').remove();
                    }
                }
            });
        }

    <script>
        const appDownloadBar = document.getElementById('android-app-download-bar-b2');
        if (appDownloadBar) {
            let initSession = sessionStorage.getItem('initSession');

            if (!initSession) {
                initSession = Date.now();
                sessionStorage.setItem('initSession', initSession);
            }

            const elapsedTime = Date.now() - initSession;
            if (elapsedTime >= 35000) {
                appDownloadBar.classList.add('show-banner');
            } else {
                setTimeout(() => {
                    appDownloadBar.classList.add('show-banner');
                }, 35000 - elapsedTime);
            }
        }

        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
            const els = document.querySelectorAll('.click-ga-event');
            const ideasMenuLinks = document.querySelectorAll('.ideas-menu a');

            els.forEach((el) => {
                el.addEventListener('click', () => {
                    const eventLabel = el.getAttribute('data-event');
                    const eventName = eventLabel.replace(/ /g, '_').replace(/-/g, '_');

                    const eventPayload = {
                        'event_category': 'notification',
                        'event_label': eventLabel
                    };
                    // console.log(eventPayload)
                    gtag('event', eventName, eventPayload);
                });
            });

            ideasMenuLinks.forEach(link => {
                link.addEventListener('click', function() {
                    const name = link.dataset.event;

                    gtag('event', 'click', {
                        'event_category': 'menu_ideias',
                        'event_label': name
                    });
                });
            });

            window.addEventListener('load', function () {
                const appDownloadBar = document.getElementById('android-app-download-bar-b2');

                if (!appDownloadBar) return;

                setTimeout(() => {
                    appDownloadBar.classList.add('show');
                }, 300);

                document.addEventListener('click', function (event) {
                    const click = !appDownloadBar.contains(event.target);

                    if (click) {
                        Livewire.emit('closeBanner');
                    }
                });
            });

            document.querySelectorAll('.search-li li, #asset-option').forEach(option => {
                option.addEventListener('click', function (event) {
                    event.preventDefault();

                    const siteTop = document.querySelector('.site');
                    document.querySelectorAll('.search-li li.active, #asset-option.active')
                        .forEach(el => el.classList.remove('active'));
                    option.classList.add('active');

                    const optionId = this.getAttribute('data-id');
                    const sectionId = document.getElementById(optionId);

                    if (optionId == 'all') {
                        siteTop.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
                    } else {
                        sectionId.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
                    }
                })
            })

        });
